runs: >x< Lists allow you to customize, organize and prioritize the posts you see in your timeline. You can choose to join Lists created by others on >x<, or from your own account you can choose to create Lists of other accounts by group, topic or interest. Viewing a List timeline will show you a stream of posts from only the accounts on that List. You can also pin your favorite Lists to the top of your timeline so you never miss a post from the accounts that are most important to you.
